result.description:
Hospitality Management

CH on Peel Pty Ltd is looking for another full-time member for its management team. Situated in the heart of Tamworth, our operations include the 62 room CH Boutique Hotel, the heritage listed DECO Wine Bar & Restaurant, Hopscotch Restaurant, the Pavilion Function & Conference Centre, Pig & Tinder Box Restaurant & Bar, The Bureau, and the Dungowan Brewery. All our restaurants are full service dine in establishments.

The Position

You will have an opportunity to further develop your hospitality skills and experience work in a variety of areas across our food service sites. The position includes managerial level food and beverage duties and bar work. This position is suited for candidates that like to work in a fast-paced supportive team environment, with high quality table service experience preferred. The successful applicant must be available across a 7 day roster including nights and weekends.

As a member of our management team, you will be responsible for the overall running of the business from top to bottom, leading by example and maintaining high standards. You must be highly motivated and able to manage all operational elements of the business from front to back of house. You will be passionate about your job, have a superior knowledge of food and beverage, understand the order of service and ensure our clients leave having had an all-round unforgettable dining experience.

Key Duties

* Delivering exceptional Customer Service
* Maintaining the service area
* Knowledge of Food Safety requirements
* Understanding of liquor licensing laws and compliance
* Proven record managing restaurants and meeting KPI targets
* Proven financial management capabilities
* Arranging bespoke events
* Experience in training staff with cultural sensitivity
* Working with our chefs to update and improve menus
* Overseeing of rostering
* Selecting and training restaurant and service staff
* Stock level management
* Cash handling and register operation

The Person

* RSA Certificate Essential
* Diploma in Hospitality Operations or Similar desirable
* Previous Bar experience
* Be able to work independently
* Experience in a fast-paced hospitality environment
* Great presentation and customer service skills
* Willingness to be part of an enthusiastic and motivated team
* Willingness to jump into any task required, cleaning, food preparation and customer service
* Strong awareness of Hygiene & Food Safety Standards
* Must always be well presented, have a great work ethic and the ability to perform well under pressure
* A Positive can-do attitude and the ability to work nights & weekends

So, if you are a 'can-do' person, who thrives on new challenges; likes working in a team environment; and consistently delivers to the highest quality, then you'll fit right in and we'd like to have you on our team.

Salary package: $63,000 - $73,000 per annum plus Super depending on skills and experience

Professional presentation and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service

Job Type: Permanent / Full-time

Ferguson Plarre's Bakehouse at Waverley Gardens is seeking an experienced Store Manager (Retail Manger) to lead the day-to-day operations of our Waverley Gardens store in a management capacity. •	Oversee daily store operations and ensure effective retail performance.
•	Lead, motivate, and supervise retail team members.
•	Maintain excellent customer service standards and resolve customer concerns professionally.
•	Proactively manage stock control, merchandising, ordering, and inventory levels.

•	Monitor sales performance, store presentation, and compliance with company procedures.
•	Manage the store’s budget and financial reporting, in line with revenue forecasting, managing expenses, and ensuring financial accuracy
•	Oversee the recruitment, selection, and induction of new staff; manage ongoing performance development and professional training programs as well as rostering.
•	Ensure workplace health and safety requirements are followed.
•	Work closely with management to actively contribute to business goals and store growth.

Selection criteria:
•	Relevant Diploma qualification or higher.
•	At least 12 months of experience in the same role or a closely related role.
•	Strong leadership, communication, and organisational skills.
•	Demonstrated ability to manage retail operations in a fast-paced environment.

•	Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and public holidays as required.

result.description:
Experienced Government Communications & Engagement Specialist to support major infrastructure projects.   Your new company     
 A Government department dedicated to moving and connecting people, places, goods and services - safely, efficiently and effectively - is seeking a high-performing and innovative Project Engagement Advisor to join their small and agile team. This is a 2-year contract, based in Cairns, offering the opportunity to contribute to high-profile infrastructure projects across Far North Queensland. 
   Your new role     
 In the role of Project Engagement Advisor, you will provide strategic communication services to technical and professional staff across community engagement, issues management and stakeholder relationship management. 
   
 You will also be responsible for: 
 
 Coordinating community engagement activities for major projects, including providing project managers with ongoing strategic communications advice, and developing and implementing communication strategies 
 Developing strategies for stakeholder management and consulting with a wide range of interest groups 
 Leading landholder engagement and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders 
 Acting as a key liaison for community and stakeholder enquiries 
 Managing issues and providing strategic advice to protect and enhance project outcomes 
 Acting as a single point of contact for project teams across engagement and communications matters 
 Managing the preparation of communication materials, including ministerial and executive correspondence and stakeholder communications 
 Supporting engagement activities that align with regional and departmental objectives 
 Complying with the WH&S Act, Regulations and Department Policy 
 Demonstrating the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 We are seeking an insightful individual with experience in a strategic communication or stakeholder engagement role, preferably within government or infrastructure environments, as this is critical to your success. 
 Demonstrated experience managing ministerial and executive correspondence, with the ability to deliver customer-focused outcomes 
 Strong understanding of media, government and regional operations, including the ability to develop informed media and communication responses 
 Proven ability to apply issues and reputation management principles and provide well-considered strategic advice 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information in a clear and non-technical manner 
 Demonstrated experience building and maintaining effective stakeholder relationships 
 Ability to gather insights, identify opportunities for improvement, and embrace innovation 
 Adaptability and resilience when working in dynamic and evolving environments 
 Strong knowledge of community engagement practices, with the ability to provide high-level advice to regional management 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 In return, you will gain a 2-year contract with the opportunity to work on high-profile infrastructure projects that have a direct impact on communities across Far North Queensland. You will further develop your skills in stakeholder engagement, communications and issues management, while working in a role that offers genuine ownership and influence. You will receive an attractive AO5 hourly rate + super and enjoy a convenient location in Cairns - working in a well-established, supportive and collaborative team environment. 
   What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, or for more information, please contact Isabel Azcune at Hays on 07 4049 2901 or email Isabel.Azcune@hays.com.au 
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you're exploring new opportunities, please contact us for a confidential conversation about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.
